### Features
- Added template functionality for backpacks useful for starter backpacks, quest backpacks or similar kind of setups. Multiple commands to work with the templates:
    - /sbp template create <templateName> [override]: Creates a template from a backpack held in the main hand
    - /sbp template delete <templateName>: Deletes the specified template
    - /sbp template list Lists all templates
    - /sbp template give <templateName> [targets]: Creates a unique backpack based on the template name specified
    - /sbp template export <templateName>: Exports template as a datapack

### Features

### Features
- Added advanced jukebox upgrade

    - Has controls to go skip between discs played
    - Allows playing discs in random order by using Shuffle toggle
    - Allows repeating all or the current disc played
